entries.f9e4f1a95dcf4314: The group sets as its basic management policy to contribute widely to society in the field of the food industry and strive to improve corporate value, and makes it its mission to provide food ingredients for consumers to realize a comfortable dietary life. It has formulated a medium-term plan, "Reborn & Growing 2028 (2024-2028)," with fiscal 2024 as the first year, and is working on strengthening sales activities and improving productivity. As basic strategies for its medium- to long-term management strategy, it sets out strengthening technical capabilities and realizing high quality that other companies cannot follow, rebuilding the frozen foods division by clarifying priority fields and product groups to focus on, strengthening organizational capabilities through review of organization and operations and awareness reform, improving human capital through improving employee satisfaction and developing human resources, and ensuring sustainability through appropriate responses to environmental changes.
